Danielle — great context, thanks. High level answers and recommended mapping below; Rishi (cc) will include concrete numbers next.

- Metered credits vs retention seat: metered is lower entry cost and scales with variable ingestion; seat (retention tier) gives predictable monthly cost and is cheaper per-GB at steady-state high volumes. Given your spike profile (12GB baseline, 40GB spikes), a blended approach is often best: prepaid credits sized for baseline + short-term overage metering for spikes.

- HSM hybrid: yes — we offer a dedicated HSM seat for steady low-latency requests plus an overflow per-request pool billed at a lower per-1000-ops rate. Seat guarantees latency/SLA and isolation; overflow handles burst.

Ask: can you confirm whether any Healwell workload requires strict per-transaction HSM attest logs (we can include those in the audit quota) and the approximate QPS during your analytics runs?

Rishi — can you run a sample 12/40GB-day model with a 90-day retention seat vs prepaid credits and include first-year pilot concessions? Also include seat+overflow HSM pricing and a proposal for amortizing audit-credit purchases across 12 months for accounting.

Thanks,
Monica

Hi Danielle / Monica — attaching a worked pricing workbook (pricing_workbook_v3.xlsx). Key scenarios below — numbers are list, we can apply discounts based on commit.

Scenario A — Metered + overflow HSM
- Audit-log ingestion: $0.045 per GB ingested
- Prepaid credits: $40k = ~888,888 GB credits (applied monthly) — we can amortize as $3.33k/month for 12 months. (This is to show math; we’ll size to your baseline.)
- HSM overflow: $0.65 per 1k ops; no seat commitment.
- Effective blended first-year price (assuming baseline 12GB/day, 90-day retention via storage): ~ $2.8k/month plus spike overage.

Scenario B — 90-day retention seat + HSM seat
- Audit-log retention seat (90d): $18k/month (covers baseline + typical spikes assumed)
- Dedicated HSM seat: $5,200/month (includes 1.5k ops/sec SLA)
- Overflow per-request: $0.35 per 1k ops beyond seat
- Effective blended first-year price: ~$23k/month (seat-heavy)

Discount/concession recommendations (pilot to commit):
- Pilot discount: 30% off audit-log ingestion for first 3 months (credits applied).
- HSM seat: 20% off first-year seat fee for a 12-month committed seat.
- If Healwell commits to a 12-month minimum ARR of $250k across hosted + addons, we can add a $30k audit-credit grant applied month-over-month (amortized).

Notes:
- We can move audit-log overage to a 30-day bill cycle to help smoothing.
- Retention tier pricing scales: 30/90/365 day seats have step-down per-GB costs; 90 is typically the balance between cost and compliance needs.

I’ve included the per-line math in the attachment. If you want I can also generate a PO-friendly line-item sheet (net30/60 options).

Best,
